subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection use reset-focused semantics in the menu bar while highest-usage ranking uses maximum constrained usage when another model family remains usable?
rationale: Current main prefers usable lanes, while this PR deliberately gives the menu-bar and highest-usage consumers different selection semantics; tests can verify either policy but cannot establish which user-visible contract maintainers intend.

options.title: Approve context-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-usage Overview ranking, then fix every supported cadence alias and prove both consumers with live output.

options.title: Use one constrained-lane policy
options.body: Select the same most-constrained quota lane in both consumers so ranking and displayed text cannot diverge.

options.title: Preserve usable-lane behavior
options.body: Continue preferring a usable family whenever one exists and narrow the change to exhausted-reset presentation only.

recommendation.title: Approve context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection and maximum-usage Overview ranking, then fix every supported cadence alias and prove both consumers with live output.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner was explicitly asked to confirm this user-visible selection policy and is the strongest available product-direction owner.
